rows.comment: <strong>It lacks the cheeky humour that characterised his three most inspired hits (8 Women
rows.verdict_le10: <strong>It lacks the cheeky humour that characterised his three most inspired hits (8 Women
rows.dek_lead: It lacks the cheeky humour that characterised his three most inspired hits (8 Women, Potiche and Sitcom), instead favouring the mournful tone of his drama Under the Sand. Still, Frantz feels like new territory for Ozon.

rows.title: Review: François Ozon's FRANTZ, Sumptuous, Subversive, Touching and Relevant
rows.comment: Beautifully nuanced and poignant and still encompassing all the Ozon film characteristics
rows.verdict_le10: Beautifully nuanced and poignant and still encompassing all the Ozon film characteristics
rows.dek_lead: Beautifully nuanced and poignant and still encompassing all the Ozon film characteristics – secrets, sexuality, twisty genre conventions and its searing political undertones, Frantz is Ozon’s most accomplished film to date.
